No, that's not a mistake. When an order ships in several parcels, each parcel shows as a separate charge on your card—so two boxes means two charges. This is normal.

However, if you see a **pending authorisation** still showing alongside the posted charges, that will drop off in **3–7 business days** depending on your bank, and Leafy can't speed that up. If both charges have already posted and you believe one is truly duplicate, let me know your order number and the last four digits of your card, and we can investigate a refund within **3 business days** of confirmation.
